title: Who Is Rahul Gandhi? Education, Career, Yatras and Role as Leader of Opposition
seoTitle: Who Is Rahul Gandhi? Education, Career and Yatras
seoDescription: Rahul Gandhi is the Congress MP for Rae Bareli and Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition since 2024. His verified degrees, career timeline and the two yatras.
excerpt: Verified degrees from Rollins and Cambridge, a year-by-year career table from Amethi to Rae Bareli, the two Bharat Jodo marches, and what fact-checkers found about viral clips of him.
